title: Use of Nasal Inhalers "Energy Sticks" in Singapore
what_it_is: Use of Nasal Inhalers "Energy Sticks" in Singapore

sections.label: Monitoring vaping products and flavours
sections.summary: MOH and HSA monitor vaping products, especially marketing targeting the young, and will evaluate them for harmful ingredients like nicotine.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health and the Health Sciences Authority (HSA) are closely monitoring their use, especially when the marketing on social media and its availability of flavours target the young.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We will continue to evaluate these products to ensure they are not adulterated with harmful ingredients, such as nicotine, as they evolve, and we will take the necessary actions to protect public health.
